answer_1.quote: Style Transfer (ST) is the task of automatically transforming text in one style into another ... we benchmark several methods and perform automatic and human evaluations on their outputs.

answer_2.quote: We compute self-BLEU which compares system outputs with the informal sentences. We also compute multi-BLEU via comparing with multiple formal rewrites on XFORMAL. ... We compute the logarithm of each sentence's probability computed by a 5-gram Kneser-Ney language model.

answer_4.quote: We sample a subset of 100 sentences from XFORMAL per language, evaluate outputs of 5 systems, and collect 5 judgments per instance. We open the task to all workers passing QC2.
answer_4.guideline: We collect formality ratings, fluency ratings, meaning preservation scores (Semantic Textual Similarity), and overall rankings (relative ranking) from human annotators.
